title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2611.30873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

translated_title: 面向模式歧义下多样化Text-to-SQL的语义感知解码
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的text-to-SQL系统常常面临模式歧义问题，即一个问题可能对应多个合理的模式元素。为了支持下游的消歧，SQL生成系统应在其top-k预测中包含多样化的解释。然而，大型语言模型（LLM）通常倾向于单一解释，产生高度偏斜的输出。我们提出了语义感知Logit调整（SLA），这是一种无需训练的解码方法，通过基于模式元素之间的语义相似性调整token logits来促进多样化的SQL生成。与以往依赖推理密集型提示或任务特定微调的方法不同，SLA高效、与模型无关且易于部署。实验表明，SLA相较标准解码持续提升了解释覆盖率，并在推理成本大幅降低的情况下与现有的多样性导向方法保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、模型无关的语义感知Logit调整（SLA）解码方法，通过基于模式元素间语义相似性调整token logits来促进多样化SQL生成，在显著降低推理成本的同时持续提升解释覆盖率。
